company.shortDescription: Nexta is a platform that allows users to transfer money and aggregate their existing payment cards into one Nexta card.
company.description: Born out of a desire to reimagine payments and money management in Egypt, nexta offers a new way to bank right from your phone. We’re focused on simplifying money management for everyone and always looking to make money tasks simple, fast, and affordable, with an evolving suite of tools and features to be added along the way.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Pre Seed round raised $3,000,000, or 57.69% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $9,251,308 to $14,299,185, a 1.55x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
